head_commit.message:
[Issue #7723] Create a maintenance flag to disable the site in cases of emergency (#9234)

## Summary

<!-- Use "Fixes" to automatically close issue upon PR merge. Use "Work
for" when UAT is required. -->
Fixes / Work for #7723  

## Changes proposed

- Updated defaultFeatureFlags.ts to remove `opportunitiesListOff: false`
and add `maintenanceMode: false`
- Updated environments.ts to add `FEATURE_MAINTENANCE_MODE` and mapping
and remove `FEATURE_OPPORTUNITIES_LIST_OFF` and mapping
- Updated proxy.ts to add maintenance mode check in the middleware. When
`maintenanceMode` is enabled, all non-API, non-maintenance-page requests
are redirected to `/maintenance`
- Updated environment_variables.tf to add `FEATURE_MAINTENANCE_MODE`
environment variable and remove `FEATURE_SEARCH_DRAWER_ON` and
`FEATURE_SEARCH_TABLE_ON` environment variables
- Updated /opportunities/page.tsx to remove `withFeatureFlag` wrapper as
the middleware now handles this instead
- Updated /opportunities/page.test.tsx to account for the removal of
`withFeatureFlag`
- Updated providerMocks.tsx to removed `opportunitiesListOff` from mock
feature flags

## Context for reviewers

We wanted to create a way to turn off the site in case of emergency.
This creates a feature flag that will redirect all pages to the
maintenance page by changing the flag in SSM.

**Note:** The new SSM parameter will need to be created and set to
"false" in all environments:
`/frontend/${var.environment}/feature-maintenance-mode`.

The following SSM parameters can be removed:
- `/frontend/${var.environment}/feature-search-table-on`
- `/frontend/${var.environment}/feature-search-drawer-on`

## Validation steps

1. Run the frontend locally. You should be able to navigate to every
page as normal.
2. To enable maintenance mode (i.e. setting the flag to true), navigate
to this url: http://localhost:3000?_ff=maintenanceMode:true
3. You will be redirected to the maintenance page. Navigating to any
other page will similarly redirect to this same maintenance page.
4. To disable maintenance mode, navigate to this url:
http://localhost:3000?_ff=maintenanceMode:false
5. You will be redirected to the home page and can now freely navigate
to any page on the site as normal.

display_title: Fix 404 pages returning HTTP 200 by using notFound() instead of JSX

head_commit.message:
Fix 404 pages returning HTTP 200 by using notFound() instead of JSX

Pages for opportunities, applications, and forms were rendering
the NotFound component as JSX (`return <NotFound />`) when resources
weren't found. This renders the "not found" UI but does not set the
HTTP status code to 404 — Next.js only sets the proper status when
the notFound() function from next/navigation is called.

Replace all `return <NotFound />` with `notFound()` across 4 pages:
- opportunity/[id]/page.tsx
- applications/[applicationId]/page.tsx
- applications/[applicationId]/form/[appFormId]/page.tsx
- print/application/[applicationId]/form/[appFormId]/page.tsx

Also removes the now-unused NotFound component imports.

Fixes #5774

Signed-off-by: V Govindarajan <vijay.govindarajan91@gmail.com>
